title: Unified Citizen Case Management Platform
buyer: Ministry of Digital Government (illustrative federal entity)
data_classification: Confidential — personal data of natural persons, processed on behalf of a federal entity
description: Design, hosting and operation of a case management platform processing citizen personal data, integrated with the national digital identity service. Award is a single primary supplier with an optional secondary supplier for disaster recovery, which is why upstream dependency overlap across the bid field is material to the award decision.
_weights_note: Category weights are set by the buyer, not by the tool, and are printed in every report. UAE Federal Law No. 11 of 2023 Art. 22(4) requires the tender announcement to state the weight assigned to each evaluation criterion in advance. A sensitivity analysis showing how far the result depends on these particular numbers is produced with every assessment.
_synthetic_notice: FICTIONAL BIDDERS. All three companies are invented and their domains are under .example (RFC 2606, reserved and non-resolvable). All evidence in cassette.json was generated by scenarios/build_demo.py. No statement in this scenario describes any real organisation.
